summary: Quarantine workflow for returned corporate laptop: temporary desk relocation and badge revalidation (EMEA site)
description:
Issue summary:
A contractor returned a corporate laptop for repair after suspected water exposure. Facilities has placed the device in quarantine locker Q3. The contractor needs a temporary desk and badge revalidated to complete final handoff and obtain a replacement device.

Impact:
- Contractor unable to complete offboarding checklist (asset transfer) without on-site access.
- Potential security risk until badge revalidation and device handoff are complete.

Location and context:
- Office: Redwood EMEA Hub (Tower B, 4th floor)
- Locker: Q3 (near shipping bay 2)
- Returned asset tag: RW-EMEA-84721
- Returned by: Contract maintainer (external vendor) on 2026-03-09

Steps already taken:
1) Shipping logged item into quarantine locker (Facilities).
2) Hardware-ops notified and scheduled bench check for 2026-03-12.
3) Contractor's badge was auto-deactivated by SSO on 2026-03-10 at 18:20 as part of offboarding.

Requested actions (this ticket):
- Facilities: provision a temporary desk (hotdesk slot) near shipping bay with a guest LAN port and a temporary 1-week chair assignment.
- Security/IT: perform manual badge revalidation with limited access (floor 4, shipping bay, quarantine locker) for contractor between 09:00-12:00 on 2026-03-12. Log changes in access-control audit.
- Shipping: coordinate a courier or internal transfer to move quarantined device to hardware bench after badge is revalidated.
- Hardware-ops: capture initial bench-check notes and quarantine photos, then decide next steps (repair vs RMA).

Desired timeline: badge revalidation + desk provisioning by 2026-03-12 morning; bench check completed same day; device moved to bench by 12:30.

Attachments: photos of locker label, shipping manifest, RW-EMEA-84721 asset tag (uploaded to ticket attachments).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:25 - Facilities (Liam O'Connor): Logged locker Q3 occupancy and placed a 'quarantine' notice. Temporary desk availability: hotdesk-4B free on 3/12 morning. Will stage chair and power cable at 08:30.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Security (Anika Rao): Noted badge auto-deactivated. We can revalidate to limited scope for a 3-hour window but require written confirmation from manager. Please attach manager approval or ticket will be escalated.
2026-03-10 13:14 - Reporter (Maya Chen): Manager approval attached: email from Julian Park approving limited revalidation 03/12 09:00-12:00. Please proceed.

2026-03-11 16:40 - Shipping (Diego Morales): Courier options compared: internal handoff preferred to avoid external transit while device is wet. We'll schedule internal transfer at 11:45 on 03/12 to deliver to HW bench (Room B12).
2026-03-12 09:08 - Security (Anika Rao): Revalidation complete — badge reissued with scope: floor-4, room-B12, shipping-bay-2, expires 2026-03-19. Access audit logged: AU-2026-03-12-789.

2026-03-12 12:55 - Hardware-ops (Omar Patel): Bench check performed. Initial findings: corrosion visible around USB-C jack, device powers on intermittently. Took photos (bench-photos-84721.zip). Recommended: RMA to vendor; preservation of forensic evidence in case of warranty dispute. Will file RMA request and copy shipping for return pickup.
investigation_notes: Facilities confirmed locker Q3 has no HVAC or water exposure; locker is plastic-lined. No other items quarantined in same rack.
Hardware-ops: serial console logs show repeated USB-C power draw spikes consistent with short circuit when charging. Battery health degraded to 56%.
Security: badge revalidation required manager approval per policy RW-SEC-ACC-03 due to offboarding status. Manual exception logged for this case.
Shipping: recommended internal handoff due to moisture risk and to preserve chain-of-custody for warranty claim.
resolution: Temporary desk and badge revalidation completed on 2026-03-12. Hardware bench-check performed; device flagged for RMA. Shipping scheduled for vendor pickup on 2026-03-14. Follow-ups: Hardware-ops to file RMA (PR-84721-RMA), Security to close manual access exception after 2026-03-19 expiry, Facilities to clear locker Q3 after pickup.
sra_notes: Manual badge exception approved by Julian Park (Manager)
